note: Floating screen: it is drawn through a portal into the page body and placed against the window, so the reference is the whole default 1280x800 window on the app's backdrop and every box is in window coordinates. The dialog that edits a Project's or Workspace's Instructions (stock-ui/instructions), opened from a project's or workspace's menu in the sidebar. Props are `InstructionsScreenProps`: `scope` (project or workspace), `id`, `name`, and `load()` and `save(text, folders)` which the core answers. The harness answers them from the fixture: `loaded` is what `load` resolves (null: the core did not answer), `saved` what `save` resolves (an `error` is the core's refusal; null: no answer), and `loading` makes `load` never answer. The dialog shell is the stock `Dialog` shell (a dimmed backdrop and one panel, 30 rem wide at most 92% of the window, 16 px of padding, the title, then the form; the `dialog` screen), which the screen draws through @perch/sdk's `Dialog`. The two fields are text areas of 9 and 4 rows; the second is one absolute path per line, in the monospace font. The counter next to Instructions is the text's length over the core's cap. Save closes the dialog on success (a no-op here), so no state shows a saved dialog; Cancel closes it. Each output's sdk.props has the props the screen was given, without the core's answers (the fixture's `loaded` and `saved`).
